FN-G5YK2C6-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 114
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 114 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Real Estate
Appraisers Board until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
